_comment: Minimum mean score per metric for the eval gate (python -m eval.run_ragas --gate). Floors set on the Acme baseline (2026-11-09, hybrid, 26 questions: faithfulness 0.77, answer_relevancy 0.69, context_recall 0.91, context_precision 0.96), each about 0.1 under it because the judge is an LLM. The knowledge base moved to ReplyHub on 2026-11-18; re-run the paid eval on it and adjust the floors to the new baseline.
